AND corpus_type = #{corpusType}
AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY sequence_order ASC
